ticker.name: Western Asset Global Corporate Defined Opportunity Fund Inc.

business_summary: Western Asset Global Corporate Defined Opportunity Fund Inc. is a closed ended fixed income mutual fund launched and managed by Legg Mason Partners Fund Advisor, LLC. The fund is co-managed by Western Asset Management Company, Western Asset Management Company Pte. Ltd., Western Asset Management Company Ltd., and Western Asset Management Company Limited. It invests in the fixed income markets across the globe. The fund invests in investment grade debt securities. It employs intensive proprietary research to create its portfolio. The fund benchmarks the performance of its portfolio against the Barclays Capital Global Aggregate Corporate Index. It was formerly known as Western Asset Global Credit Defined Opportunity Fund Inc. Western Asset Global Corporate Defined Opportunity Fund Inc. was formed on September 17, 2009 and is domiciled in the United States.
business_summary_ko: Western Asset Global Corporate Defined Opportunity Fund Inc.는 Legg Mason Partners Fund Advisor, LLC가 시작하고 관리하는 폐쇄형 고정 수입 뮤추얼 펀드입니다. 이 펀드는 Western Asset Management Company, Western Asset Management Company Pte.가 공동 관리합니다. Ltd., Western Asset Management Company Ltd. 및 Western Asset Management Company Limited가 있습니다. 전 세계 채권 시장에 투자합니다. 본 펀드는 투자등급 채무증권에 투자합니다. 포트폴리오를 만들기 위해 집중적인 독점 연구를 사용합니다. 이 펀드는 Barclays Capital Global Aggregate Corporate Index를 기준으로 포트폴리오 성과를 벤치마킹합니다. 이전에는 Western Asset Global Credit Defined Opportunity Fund Inc.로 알려졌습니다. Western Asset Global Corporate Defined Opportunity Fund Inc.는 2009년 9월 17일에 설립되었으며 미국에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
